outcome: admission to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included 244 births with complete uterine rupture after the start of labor in all maternity units in Norway between 1967 and 2008.
finding: Intrapartum/infant death after complete uterine rupture significantly decreased over the decades, with time to delivery >30 minutes and placental separation and/or fetal extrusion having the highest association with intrapartum/infant deaths.
